verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's Router documents built-in retry logic across deployments and providers, with configurable num_retries and fixed or exponential backoff. After retries are exhausted it automatically falls back to backup model groups. Missing for 10: documentation of per-error-type retry policies (e.g., which transient errors trigger a retry and how), and independent or hands-on corroboration that retries behave as claimed.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can set automatic retry policies for transient provider errors

citations.quote: Basic reliability logic - cooldowns, fallbacks, timeouts and retries (fixed + exponential backoff) across multiple deployments/providers.
Built-in retry / fallback logic across multiple deployments via the [Router](/docs/routing)
If a call fails after num_retries, LiteLLM falls back to another model group
